image_description: A red rectangular sign mounted horizontally on beige horizontal siding. The sign features large, distorted white lettering that appears to be gibberish or melted text ('NISCP' followed by garbled characters). There is a small circular emblem on the left side of the sign. The sign lacks a visible vertical post, appearing attached directly to the wall/siding.
